## Details

<a id="note_lengths"></a>
### [`note_lengths`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L6) `$9EF3-$9F12`

*data*

Note lengths in music ticks, 16 words. Event bytes $c0-$cf select entry 0-15. Command $f4 adds two entries. No tune uses the entries 12-15.

- **Read by:** [`music_command`](commands.md#music_command), [`cmd_length_sum`](commands.md#cmd_length_sum)

<a id="tempo_latches"></a>
### [`tempo_latches`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L12) `$9F13-$9F34`

*data*

CIA 1 timer B values for command $f6 (tempo), 17 words. Each value is 1000000 / rate, for 16 to 80 music ticks each second. A larger value gives a slower tune. The values assume a 1 MHz clock, so a PAL C64 plays the tunes 1.5% slower. No tune uses the entries 0-9.

- **Read by:** [`cmd_tempo`](commands.md#cmd_tempo)

<a id="voice_sid_offsets"></a>
### [`voice_sid_offsets`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L19) `$9F35-$9F37`

*data*

Offset of the SID registers of voice 0, 1 and 2 (0, 7, 14) in the SID copy at $31.

- **Read by:** [`music_tick`](tick.md#music_tick), [`count_note_lengths`](note_time.md#count_note_lengths), [`effect_pitch_step`](../sound/effects.md#effect_pitch_step), [`effect_pulse_sweep`](../sound/effects.md#effect_pulse_sweep), [`effect_freq_slide`](../sound/effects.md#effect_freq_slide), [`start_sound_request`](requests.md#start_sound_request)

<a id="voice_effect_offsets"></a>
### [`voice_effect_offsets`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L22) `$9F38-$9F3A`

*data*

Offset of voice 0, 1 and 2 in the effect phase tables at $0200 and $0209 (3 phases each).

- **Read by:** [`start_note`](tick.md#start_note), [`cmd_instrument`](commands.md#cmd_instrument), [`update_effects`](../sound/effects.md#update_effects)

<a id="music_cmd_bytes"></a>
### [`music_cmd_bytes`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L25) `$9F3B-$9F44`

*data*

The command bytes $f0-$f9 of the tune data. The driver compares an event byte with each entry.

- **Read by:** [`music_command`](commands.md#music_command)

<a id="music_cmd_handlers"></a>
### [`music_cmd_handlers`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L29) `$9F45-$9F58`

*data*

Handler of each command $f0-$f9: rest, restart, end, instrument, length, goto, tempo, call, return, filter.

- **Read by:** [`music_command`](commands.md#music_command)

<a id="filter_setting_ptrs"></a>
### [`filter_setting_ptrs`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L34) `$9F59-$9F78`

*data*

Pointers to the 16 filter settings of command $f9. No tune uses the settings 0 and 9.

- **Read by:** [`cmd_filter`](commands.md#cmd_filter)

<a id="filter_setting_00"></a>
### [`filter_setting_00`](../../../../src/music/driver_tables.asm#L40) `$9F79-$9F83`

*data*

Filter setting, 11 bytes. Bytes 0-4: step delay, cutoff high, cutoff low, resonance and routing, mode. Then 3 phases: cutoff step (x 8), step count.

- **Entry of:** [`filter_setting_ptrs`](../../tables.md#filter_setting_ptrs)
